Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-I (X-ray Technician) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Technical Support-I (X-ray Technician).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-I (X-ray Technician) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Technical Support-I (X-ray Technician) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have passed 10th with a Diploma in Radiation Technology (DRT) and two years of experience, or a B.Sc. in Radiography / Medical Imaging Technology with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I (X-ray Technician) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 18000 Per Month plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and potentially a Screening/Scrutiny Test if required.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the AIIMS Jodhpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur is located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, with the pincode 342005.
